name: circulation_card
document_label: Mexican vehicle circulation card (tarjeta de circulación)

fields.owner_name: full name of the owner (nombre del propietario) exactly as printed
fields.validity: validity (vigencia) exactly as printed; may be a word like CONDICIONADA or a date
fields.registration_number: 10-digit número de registro de la entidad (Nuevo León-style cards only)

vin.description: 17 caracteres alfanuméricos, sin I, O ni Q

extra_instructions: The card may be rotated 90 degrees: read every digit carefully, character by character, and do not drop or merge digits. Layouts change by state. registration_number is ONLY the 'número de registro de la entidad' printed on some state cards; if the card prints a 'No. Tarjeta' instead, leave registration_number empty and put that number in card_number. Never copy one into the other. validity must be copied exactly as printed (it can be a word such as CONDICIONADA or a date); do not substitute the issue date. On cards that print make and line together in one 'Vehículo' field, split them: brand = manufacturer, model_line = the rest.
